=== backend/Dockerfile ===
# Single image for all three Node processes in the stack: the HTTP API
# (start:core_backend), the pg-boss job worker (start:worker) and the one-shot
# DB migrator (start:migrate). The compose file runs the same image and only
# swaps the `command`, so build + cache are shared across backend/worker/migrate.
#
# Build context is `backend/` (see docker-compose.yml in the repo root). The image mirrors
# ml-service/Dockerfile's co-located convention.

# ---- Stage 1: Install all dependencies ----
FROM node:22-alpine AS deps

WORKDIR /app

COPY package.json package-lock.json ./
COPY workspaces/backend-api-types/package.json ./workspaces/backend-api-types/
COPY workspaces/backend-utils/package.json ./workspaces/backend-utils/
COPY workspaces/database/package.json ./workspaces/database/
COPY workspaces/core-backend/package.json ./workspaces/core-backend/
COPY workspaces/database-migrator/package.json ./workspaces/database-migrator/

RUN npm ci

# ---- Stage 2: Build TypeScript ----
FROM deps AS build

COPY tsconfig.base.json tsconfig.json ./
COPY workspaces/ ./workspaces/

RUN npm run build

# ---- Stage 3: Production image ----
FROM node:22-alpine AS production

WORKDIR /app

# ffmpeg is used by core-backend for video frame extraction (see videoFrames.ts).
# mupdf-tools (mutool) + tesseract-ocr are used by the assignment OCR pipeline
# (see utils/ocr/ocr.ts); the `deu` traineddata is required by its `-l deu` flag.
# wget is used by the compose healthcheck.
RUN apk add --no-cache ffmpeg mupdf-tools tesseract-ocr tesseract-ocr-data-deu wget

COPY --from=deps /app/package.json /app/package-lock.json ./
COPY --from=deps /app/workspaces/backend-api-types/package.json ./workspaces/backend-api-types/
COPY --from=deps /app/workspaces/backend-utils/package.json ./workspaces/backend-utils/
COPY --from=deps /app/workspaces/database/package.json ./workspaces/database/
COPY --from=deps /app/workspaces/core-backend/package.json ./workspaces/core-backend/
COPY --from=deps /app/workspaces/database-migrator/package.json ./workspaces/database-migrator/

RUN npm ci --omit=dev

COPY --from=build /app/workspaces/backend-api-types/dist/ ./workspaces/backend-api-types/dist/
COPY --from=build /app/workspaces/backend-utils/dist/ ./workspaces/backend-utils/dist/
COPY --from=build /app/workspaces/database/dist/ ./workspaces/database/dist/
COPY --from=build /app/workspaces/core-backend/dist/ ./workspaces/core-backend/dist/
COPY --from=build /app/workspaces/database-migrator/dist/ ./workspaces/database-migrator/dist/

# Media storage for locally-persisted technical term images & videos. The
# compose file mounts a named volume here; the directory matches the default
# MEDIA_STORAGE_DIR env var.
#
# Ownership must be set before the VOLUME line: Docker copies the image
# directory's ownership onto a named volume only when it first creates it, so
# volumes that already exist need a manual chown (see README).
RUN mkdir -p /app/media && chown node:node /app/media
VOLUME ["/app/media"]

ENV NODE_ENV=production
ENV MEDIA_STORAGE_DIR=/app/media
EXPOSE 4000

# `node` (uid 1000) ships with the base image. Runtime writes only ever target
# /app/media and os.tmpdir(), and 4000/4001 are unprivileged, so nothing here
# needs root — while ffmpeg/mutool/tesseract parse untrusted uploads, which is
# the surface this limits. Applies to the worker and migrate services too;
# they reuse this image and override only the command.
USER node

# Default process is the HTTP API. The `worker` and `migrate` compose services
# override this with `npm run start:worker` / `npm run start:migrate`.
CMD ["npm", "run", "start:core_backend"]
=== ml-service/Dockerfile ===
FROM python:3.11-slim

WORKDIR /app

RUN apt-get update && \
    apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends build-essential curl && \
    rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

COPY requirements.txt .
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir torch torchvision --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cpu && \
    pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt

COPY . .

# python:3.11-slim ships no unprivileged account, so create one. The only
# runtime write target is the HuggingFace cache (HF_HOME, a named volume in
# compose); code in /app and site-packages stay root-owned and read-only.
# Ownership must be set here so Docker copies it onto the volume when it first
# creates it — pre-existing ml_model_cache volumes need a manual chown (see README).
RUN useradd --create-home --uid 1000 --shell /usr/sbin/nologin app && \
    mkdir -p /cache/huggingface && \
    chown -R app:app /cache/huggingface

USER app

EXPOSE 8000

HEALTHCHECK --interval=30s --timeout=5s --start-period=180s --retries=3 \
  CMD curl -fsS http://localhost:8000/health || exit 1

CMD ["uvicorn", "main:app", "--host", "0.0.0.0", "--port", "8000"]

observation.command: cd /workspace && echo "=== backend/Dockerfile ===" && cat backend/Dockerfile && echo "=== ml-service/Dockerfile ===" && cat ml-service/Dockerfile
